item.sanguine_networks.wandUse: First shift r-click on the Ara Vitae, then shift r-click on a Virtual Sacrificer or an output port
jei.sanguine_networks.catalyst_effect: Multiplies blood production; amount depends on the model
jei.sanguine_networks.combined_models: Virtual Sacrificer only: sums blood from all four inner models at the Extra HNN tier. Power: 10× the sum of their recipe costs. Consumes one catalyst use per completed cycle. Cannot be used in Suffering Incorporated.
sanguine_networks.port.instructions: Replace shell glass with ports. Right-click with an empty hand to cycle modes; shift-right-click with an empty hand to unlink an altar.
sanguine_networks.port.require_output: Set this port to output mode before linking an Ara Vitae
sanguine_networks.suffering.boost_rule: Four catalyst slots. Boosts add together: four 5× catalysts give 20×. Each slot spends one use per completed model cycle.
sanguine_networks.suffering.energy_rule: Each active catalyst slot after the first adds 50% energy cost.
sanguine_networks.suffering.output: Extract Essentia Vitae from an output port, or link the port to an Ara Vitae with a wrench. Receiving altar sacrifice bonuses apply.
sanguine_networks.suffering.runes: Any NeoVitae altar runes may replace blank runes. All shell runes are decorative.
sanguine_networks.suffering.status.8: Suffering Incorporated is disabled in the config
sanguine_networks.suffering.structure: Hollow 7×7×7: 49 runes on the floor, blood-stained glass walls and ceiling. Controller in a wall directly above the floor; ports replace glass.
